earnings.title: Workday Announces Fiscal 2027 Third Quarter Financial Results
highlights: Fiscal Third Quarter Total Revenues of $2.705 Billion, Up 11.2% Year-Over-Year
Total revenues were $2.705 billion, an increase of 11.2% from the same period last year.
Operating income was $329 million, or 12.1% of revenues, compared to an operating income of $259 million, or 10.7% of revenues, in the same period last year .
Current quarter operating income was impacted by restructuring expenses of $51 million.
Subscription Revenues of $2.532 Billion, Up 12.8% Year-Over-Year

quotes.text: The past few quarters have been our strongest on the innovation and invention front, and in Q3, our AI products drove nearly $150 million in new ACV, more than three times what we delivered a year ago .
quotes.by: Aneel Bhusri, co-founder, CEO, and chair, Workday

quotes.text: Our Q3 results reflect ongoing adoption across our AI portfolio, reinforcing our conviction in the compelling opportunity ahead.

outlook: Subscription revenues of $2.600 billion, representing growth of 10%
Subscription revenues of $9.958 billion, representing growth of 13%
